formal_model: Complete Total Deterministic Finite Automaton (Complete DFA)

terminal_state_invariants.subsequent_event_handling: Transition to TRAP for all 13 symbols

total_completeness_proof: Total mapping verified: ∀ q ∈ Q, ∀ σ ∈ Σ, δ(q, σ) ∈ Q without omissions or undefined cells
determinism_proof: Every cell in 9 × 13 matrix has exactly one single deterministic target state

verdict_semantics.ACCEPTED: Sequence finishes in accepting state CLOSED with all transitions valid
verdict_semantics.INCOMPLETE_VALID: Sequence transitions are valid so far but final state ∉ F
verdict_semantics.REJECTED: Sequence incurs one or more invalid transitions and enters TRAP
